pre_mortem: Is the market health GO (broad index in an uptrend)?
Is the stop a single-digit % from the entry pivot?
Is this a 1st or 2nd base — not a late 4th/5th base?
Is there meaningful overhead supply above the pivot?
Am I chasing an extended price more than 5% past the pivot?
Does the position size fit inside my portfolio heat budget?
Have I written the exit plan (stop + target) before entering?
